messages:
Priya Rao: Heads up — EdgeCost sent a renewal quote with a new 'priority routing' line and list price increases (~18%).
Ben Carter: yikes. can you drop the quote snippet?
Priya Rao: sure, pasted:
```
EdgeCost Renewal Q1 2026
- Enterprise base: $22,500/mo
- Priority routing add-on: $4,050/mo
- Embedding overage: $0.0025 per embedding
- Annual discount: none quoted (term 12m)
```
Maya Liu: I thought we had a 10% renewal concession last year for a 12m commit.
Priya Rao: we did — Contract EC-RED-2025 recorded $240k commit and 10% applied. This new quote looks like they removed it.
Jonah Park: @billing-bot confirm last year's committed spend and net invoiced amount please.
billing-bot: Contract EC-RED-2025: committed ARR $240,000; renewal credit 10% applied. Net invoiced (2025) = $216,000.
Ben Carter: Action items: (1) Procurement to seek reinstated renewal discount or multi-year pricing, (2) Ops to request justification and metrics for the new addon, (3) Finance to produce embedding usage for the last 6 months.
Maya Liu: agree. Also ask for a month-by-month embedding count so we can model overage exposure.
Priya Rao: I'll open the renewal thread with EdgeCost. Can someone draft the email asking for: line-item justification for priority routing, historical usage tieout, renewal discount options, and a 30-day pricing hold while we reconcile?
Ben Carter: I'll draft. Proposed subject: "EdgeCost — renewal questions and pricing hold request". Draft below for quick review:
```
Hi EdgeCost team,

We received the renewal for EC-RED-2026 and have a few questions before we can proceed:
1) Please provide a line-item explanation for the new "priority routing" charge and the billing metric used.
2) Provide embedding API monthly usage for the last 6 months (counts per month) to validate overage calculations.
3) Confirm available renewal discounts for 12- or 24-month commitments and any migration/feature credits.
4) Please place the quoted pricing on a 30-day hold while we reconcile usage and contract terms.

We will not approve an auto-renewal with the addon enabled without explicit written acceptance.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
On behalf of Redwood Inference
```
Jonah Park: add a line that if they cannot reinstate discount, request a trial period for the addon or a proportional credit.
Ben Carter: added and sending now. cc: procurement@redwood, priya.
Priya Rao: Billing-bot, please attach the signed contract and last invoice to the thread.
billing-bot: Attached: contract_EC-RED-2025.pdf, invoice_2025-12.pdf
Maya Liu: Quick calc: listed annual with addon = (22,500 + 4,050) * 12 = $318,600. That's ~47% above our net last year. Big gap.
Priya Rao: unacceptable. Aim for either reinstated 10% + remove addon, or keep addon but get at least 20% off total.
Ben Carter: noted. Will update thread with EdgeCost reply when it comes in.
Priya Rao: thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround everyone :thumbsup:
